endpoints.name: Create Client

idempotency.notes: Not idempotent; a duplicate check exists so repeating usually fails with a conflict/validation message

endpoints.detailed_description: Create client. It validates the request, then checks for an existing/duplicate record, then calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IClient.GetClientById, IClient.GetInfluencerSourceByID, then processes uploaded files. Persists changes to: Client: INSERT, ComplaintsFile: INSERT. Possible responses: 200, 400, 401, 409, 500.

error_handling.validation_errors: 400: Region and Area are required [when request.RegionId <= 0 || request.AreaId <= 0]; Client type is required [when request.ClientTypeId <= 0]; Client not found [when client == null]; Invalid Organization [when organizations.Count != organizationIds.Count]; Invalid Influencer Source [when source == null]; Invalid Buying Trigger Type [when triggers.Count != buyingTriggerIds.Count]; (+4 more)
error_handling.unauthorized: 401/403: Unauthorized [when currentUser == null]; Invalid token [when currentUser == null]

ai_agent_guidance.use_when: When the user wants to create client
ai_agent_guidance.do_not_use_when: When the user only wants to view data, or the required inputs are not available yet

business_logic.validations: Region and Area are required; Client type is required; Client not found; Invalid Organization; Invalid Influencer Source; Invalid Buying Trigger Type; (+4 more)
